ticket.title: Clear stale death metadata when marking a patient alive
ticket.text:
Clear stale death metadata when marking a patient alive

Impact

Marking a deceased patient as alive leaves the previous death date and non-coded cause of death stored on the backend. Because the non-null death date remains stored, OpenMRS continues to return `dead: true` on reload.

Affected code

packages/esm-patient-registration-app/src/patient-registration/form-manager.ts

packages/esm-patient-registration-app/src/patient-registration/patient-registration.types.ts

packages/esm-patient-registration-app/src/patient-registration/form-manager.test.ts

Root cause

When `isDead` is false, the frontend sends only `dead: false` and omits the death metadata fields.

OpenMRS automatically clears the coded `causeOfDeath`, but it retains `deathDate` and `causeOfDeathNonCoded` when those properties are omitted. The retained non-null death date causes OpenMRS to keep the patient marked dead.

Reproduction

1. Open a deceased patient with a death date and non-coded cause of death.
2. Mark the patient as alive.
3. Save the patient.
4. Retrieve the patient through the REST API.
5. `dead` remains true, and the previous death metadata remains.

Expected behavior

Marking the patient as alive should clear the death date and both forms of cause-of-death metadata.

Implementation direction

When `isDead` is false, send explicit null values for `deathDate`, `causeOfDeath`, and `causeOfDeathNonCoded`.

Update the relevant TypeScript types to permit null values. The REST person resource accepts null for all three properties.

Acceptance criteria

- The payload contains `dead: false`.
- `deathDate`, `causeOfDeath`, and `causeOfDeathNonCoded` are explicitly null.
- Reloading through REST returns no stale death metadata.
- FHIR continues to represent the patient as not deceased.
- Add a unit test for the generated payload.
- Add a request-level test confirming that `dead: false` and explicit nulls for all three death metadata fields are handed to `savePatient`.

Verified against openmrs-esm-patient-management commit c64fb336, openmrs-core save handling, the webservices.rest person update contract, and the RefApp 3.8 local REST behavior.
